notes: Constant PDA could be seen as indecent (PurityVice).
Sloppy could be seen as lacking self-discipline, fussy as meticulous, relating to purity/cleanliness.
Harsh relates to HarmVice, gentle is a Care virtue.
Clinical implies lack of empathy, heartfelt implies deep feeling, relating to Care.
Inappropriate relates to indecency/wrong, seemly to propriety/decency.
Fake implies dishonesty/deceit, real implies honesty.
Rejected implies exclusion (FairnessVice) and abandonment (HarmVice, IngroupVice).
Catty implies harm/cruelty, supportive implies care/protection.
Serial dater could be seen as promiscuous (PurityVice).
Divine relates to spirituality/holiness, earthly to the opposite of elevated/spiritual.
Sassy can imply disrespect or defiance of authority.
Spartan relates to austerity and self-discipline (PurityVirtue).
Pranks can involve harm (Care), deceit (Loyalty), or be inappropriate (Purity, General).
